headline: Bitcoin Rose 1.21 Percent to 83k While Funding Stayed Negative
narrative: Bitcoin rose 1.21 percent to 83k, the live spot print after a flat flow-cycle reading of 56. Perpetual funding sat at -0.0015, a crowded-short pipe under the lift. Options skew at 27.71 still priced downside into the Oct. 14 expiry, with puts struck at 75k and calls at 92k.
author: jordan
